Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000753": As of 2025-10-15, the pager for the scheduler rings Team Dune instead of Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Dune, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000709" [decision]: On 2025-09-15, Team Dune decided that the reporting service will read from the event bus instead of querying the ledger directly because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger, Team Dune, event bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000703" [constraint]: As of 2025-09-09, changes to the billing service need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.  (about: billing service)
- memory_id "1000691" [decision]: On 2025-09-08, Team Boreal decided the billing service will gate the new invoice flow behind the feature-flags service because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch.  (about: Team Boreal, billing service, feature-flags service, new invoice flow)
- memory_id "1000625" [constraint]: As of 2025-08-14, changes to the auth gateway require two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.  (about: auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000619" [decision]: As of 2025-08-01, certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead.  (about: certificate expiry)
- memory_id "1000596": On the 2025-07-30 rotation day, Farah handed the Team Dune pager to Tomasz Nowak.  (about: Tomasz Nowak, Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000580" [decision]: On 2025-07-28, Team Cinder's standup decided that clients will cache feature-flags service evaluations for 30 seconds.  (about: Team Cinder, feature-flags service, clients)
- memory_id "1000551": As of 2025-06-20, the webhooks service lives with Team Dune; Team Atlas kept it until then, and the Ember team never held it.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Dune, webhooks service, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000464": On 2025-06-12, Team Dune noticed that the notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Dune, notifier)
- memory_id "1000450": On 2025-05-23, the Ember team observed that the webhooks service's request volume halved following the client rollout, and flagged it since the webhooks service is not the Ember team's service.  (about: webhooks service, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000389": As of 2025-04-29, the Ember team has taken over the resizer from Team Dune.  (about: Team Dune, Ember team, resizer)
- memory_id "1000383": As of 2025-04-29, the Ember team has taken over the resizer from Team Dune.  (about: Team Dune, Ember team, resizer)
- memory_id "1000379" [decision]: Ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan.  (about: ledger)
- memory_id "1000324" [decision]: On 2025-04-04, Team Dune agreed that the catalog service will keep image metadata in a separate table.  (about: Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000291": As of 2025-03-31, the auth gateway is a Team Boreal service.  (about: Team Boreal, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000273": As of 2025-03-28, the pager for the webhooks service rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000247" [decision]: The Ember team does pairing on every production change.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000241" [constraint]: The webhooks service ships only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000117": The webhooks service depends on the event bus for outbound events.  (about: event bus, webhooks service)
